standard: LOOM_CORE_STANDARD.md v1: each agent owns at most 9 knobs and its own goalposts. The centre balances the agents. Lock first, held-out data and independent methods, then the compass, then the registry.

centre.name: N0 centre referee

centre.rule: A gap is CLOSED only when its value is derived in code from earlier links, passes its goalpost on held-out or post-lock data, and survives an independent referee. FIT and PHEN never count as closed.

dataset_rule: Before scoring: fetch the current value from 3 sources and triangulate (Rule 6h: consensus within 1 sigma or 0.3 dex). Lock (PREREG + sha256), then score, then fingerprint into the compass. Only data released after the lock counts as strict evidence (G6).
target: ln L_global(agent datasets) - 0.5 * n_fitted_knobs * ln N; NAILED only on held-out/post-lock data with all gates passed
engine: tools/bloom (Unified Field Bloom): bloom.py target + 7 lenses + levers; bloom_loop.py mining/triangulation/balance; test_bloom.py readiness battery (must print READY before a step is scored); BLOOM_STEPS.md B1-B14 goalposts + lead board
